candidates.title: Brutalismus 3000 with SPFDJ, EERA, Dorian Electra
candidates.price_text: resale listings around $65; face value was on Dice
candidates.summary: Berlin's Brutalismus 3000 bring their gabber-punk-techno live show to the Knockdown Center main space, with Berlin hard-techno DJ SPFDJ, EERA and Dorian Electra on the bill. Doors 7pm in the big Maspeth warehouse room. Dice was the primary ticketing partner; resale was sitting around $65.
candidates.fit: This is the Berlin night of the week: a German duo plus SPFDJ in a raw warehouse, which is exactly the Kalkbrenner/Berlin-techno lane he keeps coming back to, and it's a Friday so he can bring two or three of the guys.

candidates.title: Mousse T. (Club night, The Atrium)
candidates.summary: Mousse T., the Hanover-based German house producer behind 'Horny '98' and a long catalogue of disco-house edits, plays the Atrium at Public Records on a Thursday. 10:30pm start in a small room with one of the best sound systems in Brooklyn. Tickets via Dice; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: German house veteran, 150-ish capacity room, Thursday night, fifteen minutes from Fort Greene. That's his main weeknight slot and his German-music lane in one booking.

candidates.title: Benji B, Cosmo / Louise Chen, Hidden Spheres / Francis Harris & Tal
candidates.summary: Benji B headlines the Sound Room at Public Records on Saturday, with Paris's Louise Chen and Cosmo in the Atrium and Hidden Spheres plus Francis Harris & Tal upstairs. Three rooms, 11pm start. Tickets on Dice; price not published on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: Benji B is a DJ who actually plays - he'll move through house, broken beat and hip-hop in one set, which lines up with how wide Konrad's library runs. Small rooms, serious sound, no bottle service anywhere in the building.

candidates.title: John Summit: CTRL ESCAPE Arena Tour with Cassian & Jackie Hollander
candidates.price_text: on sale now via AXS; resale was running $240 and up
candidates.summary: John Summit plays two nights at Barclays Center, Saturday Nov 28 and Sunday Nov 29, with Cassian and Jackie Hollander supporting. 7pm start, on sale now. This is the arena version of his sound, not a club set.
candidates.fit: Tier 1 artist, and Barclays is a walk from his door. This is the two-or-three-times-a-year big spectacle slot - the Kx5 'We Belong Here' register - and Cassian opening is the melodic-house part he actually cares about. Book it now, Thanksgiving weekend arena shows don't get cheaper.

candidates.title: Tyla
candidates.summary: Tyla plays two nights at Brooklyn Paramount, Nov 28 and Nov 29. The restored Paramount is a roughly 2,700-cap theater in Downtown Brooklyn, mobile ticketing and cashless. Exact pricing was not published on the pages that loaded.
candidates.fit: Amapiano-pop in a real theater ten minutes from Fort Greene instead of an arena. She's squarely in his current Afrobeats/amapiano phase, and the Sunday night (Nov 29) is the easier babysitter ask than the Saturday.

candidates.title: 22 Years of FIXED ft. Kelly Lee Owens (DJ set), JDH & Dave P
candidates.summary: FIXED, the long-running JDH & Dave P party, turns 22 at Good Room with Kelly Lee Owens playing a DJ set in the main room and Ivan Berko all night in the Bad Room. Tickets through Resident Advisor; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: A 22-year-old party with no marketing budget in a 400-cap Greenpoint room is exactly the 'you had to know about it' thing he says he wants. Kelly Lee Owens DJing leans melodic and trancey, which is his core sound.

candidates.title: Tarka 3-Year Anniversary: ZAINAB, Bianca Maieli, Chaia, Zara Dekho b2b Dynoman, Rohana
candidates.summary: The Tarka collective takes over the Atrium and Upstairs at Public Records for its third anniversary, starting at 4pm Sunday with a deep South Asian club and electronic lineup including Zara Dekho b2b Dynoman. Tickets on Dice; price not shown on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: A Sunday daytime dance party run by a small collective - closest thing this week to the BQE day party he loved, and it starts early enough that he's home at a reasonable hour.

candidates.title: Clone Records: Serga, Afra / Detroit In Effect, Ak-4ya / Louise Chen
candidates.summary: Rotterdam's Clone Records takes over all three Public Records spaces on Friday night, with Detroit In Effect, Serga, Ak-4ya and Louise Chen across the Sound Room, Atrium and Upstairs. 11pm start. Dice tickets, price not listed on the calendar.
candidates.fit: Label showcase, three small rooms, electro and Detroit techno on a proper sound system. If Brutalismus in a Queens warehouse is too much that Friday, this is the version where you can hear each other and talk to the bartender.

candidates.title: Flava D, Don-Ri, Made to Order: Dendi's Dad, EJWIZE, Imbueless
candidates.summary: UK garage and bassline producer Flava D headlines the full venue at Elsewhere on Saturday night, 10:30pm, with Don-Ri and locals across the rooms. Tickets through Eventbrite via Elsewhere; price not shown on the calendar listing.
candidates.fit: Bushwick, multi-room, and a UK DJ who plays fast and melodic rather than posing. Good alternative to the Gowanus option if the crew wants somewhere they can move between rooms.

candidates.title: Young Miko: Late Checkout Tour
candidates.summary: Puerto Rican rapper Young Miko brings the Late Checkout Tour to Barclays Center on Thursday Nov 5 at 8pm. Full arena production, a ten-minute walk from Fort Greene.
candidates.fit: Thursday night, walkable, Latin trap. It's a big room rather than a small one, but if the crew wants a reggaeton night without going anywhere near Manhattan, this is the one on his doorstep.

candidates.title: Shelter: Timmy Regisford Open To Close
candidates.summary: Timmy Regisford, the founder of the legendary Shelter party, plays open to close in the Public Records Sound Room starting 3pm on a Sunday. One DJ, one room, all afternoon and evening. Dice tickets; price not published on the calendar.
candidates.fit: A Sunday afternoon in a 200-cap room with a New York house institution behind the decks. This is the deep-scene, know-someone-to-hear-about-it booking, and the daytime start means he's not blowing a weekend night.

candidates.title: 718 Sessions 24th Anniversary with Danny Krivit
candidates.summary: Danny Krivit's 718 Sessions celebrates 24 years at Good Room, with Go Kiryu and Hirame in the Bad Room. Tickets via Resident Advisor; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: Twenty-four years of the same Sunday party, run by one of the last great New York disco and house DJs. No listicle has ever sent anyone here.

candidates.title: 240 Months of Riotvan ft. Panthera Krause, Peter Invasion, Timo Lee
candidates.summary: German label Riotvan marks 20 years at Good Room with Leipzig's Panthera Krause, Peter Invasion and Timo Lee, plus Mike Simonetti all night in the Bad Room. Tickets through Resident Advisor; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: A German label anniversary with German DJs in a small Greenpoint club. Slow-burn melodic house, the Riotvan house style, which is the Tinlicker/Marsh end of his taste rather than the big-room end.

candidates.title: Cinthie, Amir Alexander / Snad, Jenifa Mayanja / Edan
candidates.summary: Berlin's Cinthie headlines all three Public Records rooms on the Saturday of Thanksgiving weekend, alongside Amir Alexander, Snad, Jenifa Mayanja and Edan. 11pm start, Dice tickets, price not published.
candidates.fit: Cinthie is a Berlin house lifer who plays vinyl and plays long. If he wants the Berlin club feeling in a 200-person room rather than a warehouse, this is the night - and it's the late option if John Summit at Barclays is too obvious.

candidates.title: DURATIONS: Dasha Rush, Decoder, Innersha [Live] / Human Space Machine, Claudio PRC & Francis Harris / Afrikan Sciences
candidates.summary: The club night of Public Records' DURATIONS festival: Berlin-based Dasha Rush with Decoder and Innersha live, plus Claudio PRC b2b Francis Harris and Afrikan Sciences across the three rooms. 10pm Friday start. Dice tickets; price not published on the calendar.
candidates.fit: The one properly hypnotic techno night on the calendar this month, run as part of a festival that nobody outside the scene has heard of. Deep end of the melodic-techno lane he started with Kalkbrenner.

candidates.title: LCD Soundsystem
candidates.summary: LCD Soundsystem play a four-night run at Knockdown Center, Nov 19 through Nov 22, 8pm each night. Standing room in the Maspeth warehouse rather than a theater or arena.
candidates.fit: A band that plays dance music, in a warehouse, for four nights. It's the live-band-electronic streak in his library (Polo & Pan, Empire of the Sun) at its best, and these runs sell out - decide this week.

candidates.title: Cut Copy (DJ set), ራሄል (Rachel), Disco Bambino, Kristine Barilli, Gravitational
candidates.summary: Cut Copy play a DJ set across the full venue at Elsewhere on Friday Nov 13, 10:30pm, with Rachel, Disco Bambino and others on the other floors. Eventbrite tickets via Elsewhere; price not shown on the calendar.
candidates.fit: Indie-disco and nu-disco all night in Bushwick. It's the closest thing this month to a themed dance night he'd actually enjoy - closer to the ABBA night energy than to a bottle-service room.

candidates.title: FIXED with HAAi, JDH & Dave P
candidates.summary: HAAi headlines FIXED at Good Room on Saturday Dec 5, with JDH & Dave P, and JEWELSSEA b2b QRTR all night in the Bad Room. Tickets via Resident Advisor; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: HAAi plays big, melodic, psychedelic house - the Fred again.. and Rebūke corner of his taste - but in a 400-cap Greenpoint room instead of a festival field.

candidates.title: The Atrium: Eli Escobar, Jen Cardini
candidates.summary: Eli Escobar and Paris's Jen Cardini play the Atrium at Public Records from 4pm on the Sunday of Thanksgiving weekend. Daytime into evening, one small room. Dice tickets; price not published on the calendar.
candidates.fit: Sunday afternoon disco-house in the Atrium, which is small enough that you're basically standing next to the booth. Good low-effort end to a long holiday weekend with one friend.

candidates.title: FIXED x Synthicide present: Curses (live), JDH b2b Andi
candidates.summary: Berlin-based Curses performs live at Good Room on Sunday Dec 13, presented by FIXED and Synthicide, with JDH b2b Andi. Tickets via Resident Advisor; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: Curses lives in Berlin and makes dark, melodic, goth-leaning dance music - a live set, not a DJ set. Another Berlin-flavoured night in a room small enough to matter.

candidates.title: Juan Maclean (all night long)
candidates.summary: The Juan MacLean plays an all-night set in the main room at Good Room on Saturday Nov 21, with Tavish and Gee Dee in the Bad Room. Resident Advisor tickets; price not listed on the venue calendar.
candidates.fit: One DJ, one room, all night - the format he gets the most out of. DFA-style house and disco, zero spectacle, and you can get a drink without queueing.

candidates.title: X-Coast (open to close), 6 SENSE, K.ONE, PAN!C ROOM
candidates.summary: X-Coast plays an open-to-close set across the full venue at Elsewhere on Saturday Nov 14, 10:30pm, with 6 SENSE, K.ONE and PAN!C ROOM on the other floors. Eventbrite via Elsewhere; price not shown.
candidates.fit: Open-to-close means one DJ building a night rather than a parade of 60-minute sets. X-Coast leans breakbeat and hard house, which is the energetic end of what he likes.

candidates.title: Polymarket UFC 334: Gane vs Hokit
candidates.summary: UFC returns to the Garden on Saturday, November 14 with a numbered card: Ciryl Gane vs Josh Hokit for the heavyweight title and Kayla Harrison vs Amanda Nunes for the women's bantamweight title, plus Caio Borralho vs Yousri Belgaroui, Uros Medic vs Kevin Holland, and Stephen Thompson and Jim Miller on the prelims. Main card is 9pm ET, prelims 7pm, early prelims 5pm. Tickets are on sale through Ticketmaster; UFC does not publish face prices on the event page.
candidates.fit: This is the once-or-twice-a-year big-spectacle fight night he will pay anything for: a real UFC pay-per-view at MSG, two title fights, and a crew of three or four. He trains Muay Thai and teaches Krav Maga, so the striking matchups (Gane, Holland, Thompson) are the part he will actually argue about afterwards.

candidates.title: UFC Fight Night: Cortes Acosta vs Walker
candidates.time_text: early prelims 5pm, prelims 7pm, main card 8pm ET
candidates.venue: Broadcast only (card is at the UFC Apex, Las Vegas)
candidates.summary: Heavyweights Waldo Cortes-Acosta and Johnny Walker headline a Saturday Fight Night from Las Vegas, with Tatiana Suarez vs Virna Jandiroba underneath. It streams on Paramount+ with the main card at 8pm ET. This one is a TV night, not a ticketed New York event.
candidates.fit: The only live fight content in his Saturday window this week. Cheap plan: pick a bar with sound on, two friends, done by midnight so the 1-year-old does not win the morning.

candidates.title: Brooklyn Nets vs Oklahoma City Thunder
candidates.summary: The Thunder come to Barclays on Monday, November 30, listed on the arena's own events calendar with tickets through Ticketmaster. Tip-off time is not shown on the calendar listing, so check the detail page before buying. It is the best visiting team on the Barclays basketball schedule between now and mid-December.
candidates.fit: Not the Knicks, but it is a ten-minute walk from Fort Greene and the best roster that will be in his neighborhood this month. Worth breaking the no-Monday rule only if the guys want to see a contender up close without a Penn Station trip.

candidates.title: New York Knicks vs Chicago Bulls
candidates.summary: Knicks host the Bulls at the Garden on Wednesday, November 4 at 7:30pm, per the Ticketmaster Knicks home-schedule listing and the Yahoo Sports team calendar. Regular-season, mid-week, no marquee opponent. Tickets are open on Ticketmaster.
candidates.fit: Filed as a regular-season option only, since he said regular-season Knicks tickets are not a priority. Keep it as a bar-watch with one friend rather than a ticket buy, and save the money for the real Knicks nights later in the season.

candidates.title: New York Knicks vs Cleveland Cavaliers
candidates.summary: The Yahoo Sports Knicks November calendar shows Cleveland at the Garden on Wednesday, November 11, two nights after Milwaukee on November 10. Tip-off time is not confirmed and I could not load the NBA or MSG calendar to verify it. Treat the date as provisional until you see it on msg.com or Ticketmaster.
candidates.fit: The Cavs are the Eastern Conference measuring-stick game of this stretch, which is the only kind of regular-season Knicks ticket worth his Wednesday. Verify the time before you buy anything.

candidates.title: Gleason's Gym Monthly Boxing Show
candidates.summary: Gleason's lists a monthly boxing show on December 19 at the gym on Water Street in Dumbo. It is an amateur club show in the most storied gym in New York, run in the gym itself rather than a theater. Start time and door price are not stated in the listing I could read.
candidates.fit: Small room, no marketing, you stand ten feet from the ropes: exactly the register he likes, and it is the fight-community side of his life rather than an arena night. Amateur caliber, so this is a walk-over-from-Fort-Greene curiosity, not a main event.

candidates.title: Chef in Residence: Patxi Andres & Jay Wolman at Bar Blondeau
candidates.price_text: à la carte, price not published
candidates.summary: Bar Blondeau hands its kitchen to guest chefs Patxi Andres and Jay Wolman for a one-night residency takeover on Sunday Nov 8, 5-10pm, at the top of the Wythe Hotel. Booked through Resy as a dated event, not a normal reservation. Menu and pricing were not published in the listing.
candidates.fit: Exactly the guest-chef takeover format he asks for, in Williamsburg where he already trains, and the room is small enough to talk to the bartender. Sunday evening with the wife, no babysitter marathon required.

candidates.title: RAW WINE New York 2026
candidates.price_text: roughly $30 to $110 depending on ticket type
candidates.summary: The tenth New York edition of RAW WINE, the organic/biodynamic/low-intervention fair, lands at Industry City for two days. Sunday Nov 8 runs noon to 6pm and is open to the public as well as trade; Monday Nov 9 is noon to 5pm. Tickets run roughly $30 to $110 depending on the tier.
candidates.fit: A real natural wine fair, growers pouring their own bottles, not a brunch party. Sunday daytime in Brooklyn is his slot, and it's a few hundred producers rather than a listicle crowd.

candidates.title: The Lineup Dinner: Casey Lynfield (San Sabino)
candidates.time_text: evening seating, exact time on the booking page
candidates.price_text: not published in the listing
candidates.summary: The Lineup is a recurring one-night pop-up series that puts NYC sous chefs in charge of their own kitchen for an evening: five courses, five wines, served at the Food52 offices in Brooklyn. The November 6 seat belongs to Casey Lynfield, executive sous chef at San Sabino. Booked through OpenTable.
candidates.fit: This is the restaurant-in-restaurant format he wants: a chef nobody has written about yet, one night, a shared table, in Brooklyn. Good Friday-night plan for two or three of the guys who care about food.

candidates.title: Sushi Saito x Sushi Noz residency
candidates.price_text: $1,200 to $1,800 per person
candidates.summary: Tokyo's Sushi Saito, one of the hardest reservations in the world, takes over Sushi Noz on the Upper East Side for three nights, Nov 5 to 7 - billed as the chef's first US collaboration dinner. Seats are limited to the counter. Price was not published in the listings I could reach.
candidates.fit: The definition of a thing you had to know someone to hear about, and a counter that seats a handful of people. Flag it as a splurge date night with the wife, and call the restaurant directly because seats like this never hit a public booking page.

candidates.title: Just Jiaba Dinner by Carrie Hsu
candidates.price_text: ticket price on the Luma page
candidates.summary: A one-night ticketed dinner hosted by chef Carrie Hsu at a private space on Bond Street in Brooklyn, Friday Nov 6, 7-10pm. Tickets and the menu are on Luma. Capacity is small, as these dinners usually are.
candidates.fit: Underground dinner-party cooking in a room you'd never find on your own, a short hop from Fort Greene. Exactly the kind of plan he can drop in the group chat and look like he knows people.

candidates.title: Desolas Mezcal Tasting at Ray's
candidates.price_text: not published; RSVP through Luma
candidates.summary: A guided mezcal tasting with Desolas at Ray's, Thursday Nov 5, 6:30 to 8:30pm, RSVP through Luma. It's a bar-sized event, not a convention-hall tasting.
candidates.fit: Thursday is his night, and a mezcal tasting in a proper dive-leaning bar is the drink-focused, no-nonsense format he likes. Two guys, two hours, home at a reasonable time.

candidates.title: Sunday Roast at Cove with Flynn McGarry
candidates.address: 285 W Houston St, New York, NY 10014
candidates.price_text: à la carte, price not published
candidates.summary: Chef Flynn McGarry hosts a classic Sunday roast at Cove on West Houston, Sunday Nov 8, 5:30 to 8:30pm, bookable on Resy. One-night guest-chef format in a small dining room.
candidates.fit: A whole-roast, family-style table is the group-meal shape he likes, and McGarry cooking someone else's room for a night is the guest-takeover angle rather than a restaurant recommendation.

candidates.title: Trove Anniversary Chef's Table
candidates.price_text: ticketed on Eventbrite, price on the page
candidates.summary: Trove Wine Bar & Kitchen marks two years with a five-course chef's table dinner and wine pairing on Saturday Nov 14. Tickets through Eventbrite, one seating, small room.
candidates.fit: Five courses at a counter in a Brooklyn wine bar, booked as a ticket rather than a table - the kind of thing that sells out through regulars before anyone writes about it. Good Saturday date night in the radar window.

candidates.title: King of Drag live at 3 Dollar Bill
candidates.price_text: VIP $100 plus about $7 in fees; general admission tiers lower
candidates.summary: A King of Drag live show at 3 Dollar Bill in Brooklyn on Sunday Nov 8, doors into a 9pm show. Ticketed through Eventim, with a VIP tier at $100 face value plus fees.
candidates.fit: He already does drag nights at Phoenix with the guys; this is the drag-king side of it in a Brooklyn warehouse bar rather than a theatre. Sunday night, so treat it as the occasional late one.

candidates.title: Election Night at Xanadu Roller Arts
candidates.time_text: evening, results on screens through the night
candidates.price_text: not confirmed
candidates.summary: The Bushwick roller rink Xanadu is throwing an Election Day party on Nov 3: skate sessions, the bar open, and results on screens as they come in. Brooklyn Paper reported it on Oct 30; start time and cover were not stated in what I could read.
candidates.fit: He loves All Night Skate, and this is the same idea with a reason to be there. It's a Tuesday, so only worth it if the guys want a night with actual stakes - check the time on Xanadu's own channels before committing.

candidates.title: Chef's table dinner at Brooklyn Point (Resident)
candidates.price_text: ticketed per seat, price on the booking page
candidates.summary: Resident runs ticketed private chef's-table dinners with Michelin-background and award-winning chefs in residential spaces around the city; their listings page shows a Friday Nov 6, 2026 dinner at Brooklyn Point. Seats are sold individually and the room is small.
candidates.fit: A stranger's dining room with a serious chef cooking for a dozen people is the modern version of the apartment comedy show he loved. Downtown Brooklyn means he can walk home.

candidates.title: The Collectors Bar
candidates.price_text: cocktail-bar pricing, roughly $18 to $22 a drink
candidates.summary: A Hong Kong-inspired cocktail bar and hidden back room that opened on Grand Street in Williamsburg in February 2026, covered by Greenpointers. It's a small, drinks-first room rather than an event space. Exact drink pricing was not listed.
candidates.fit: New hidden bar in the neighborhood he already trains in, in the Raines Law Room / Sunken Harbor register rather than the line-outside register. Good post-Muay Thai stop or a two-drink date night.

candidates.title: The heated Yard at Threes Brewing
candidates.time_text: open seven days, afternoons and evenings
candidates.price_text: free to walk in; semi-private corner for up to 50 requires a beverage minimum
candidates.summary: From early November to mid-May, Threes' Gowanus yard is covered with winterized heated tents. Seven days a week you can also reserve a semi-private corner for up to 50 people against a beverage minimum. No ticket, no date.
candidates.fit: The cold-weather version of a Strong Rope sunny afternoon, and the reservable corner is the cheat code for the Friendsgiving-adjacent group hang he'll want in the next few weeks.

candidates.title: Nutcracker Rouge
candidates.time_text: evening performances; check the box office calendar for showtimes
candidates.summary: Company XIV's baroque burlesque version of The Nutcracker returns to Théâtre XIV with previews starting Thursday November 12 and closing night Saturday January 30, 2027. Twelve weeks only, all tickets on sale now, with champagne-couch and bottle upgrades at the box office. The organizer page does not publish a base price, so budget by seat type.
candidates.fit: Company XIV is already his favorite room in the city and the Nutcracker is already his favorite night out, so this is the two of them welded together. Book a champagne couch for a date night before the good seats go.

candidates.title: George Balanchine's The Nutcracker — New York City Ballet
candidates.time_text: matinees and 8pm evening performances depending on the date
candidates.price_text: opening-weekend seats listed around $137 to $377
candidates.summary: NYCB's Nutcracker runs November 27, 2026 through January 2, 2027 at the Koch Theater. Secondary listings show opening-weekend performances on Friday November 27 at 8pm and Saturday November 28 at 2pm and 8pm, with prices in the $137 to $377 range. Full company plus School of American Ballet students, Tchaikovsky score.
candidates.fit: He has called this his best night in the city, and Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker is literally in his liked songs. The good dates sell out, so this is a book-it-this-week item rather than a December scramble.

candidates.title: The Slipper Room Show!
candidates.time_text: doors 8pm, show 8:30pm and runs to midnight; come and go as you like
candidates.price_text: $40 general admission plus $1 fee; reserved main-floor seats cost more
candidates.summary: The house variety show at the Slipper Room on Friday November 6: burlesque, circus acts, sideshow and emcee chaos in a two-level room on Orchard Street. General admission is $40 with no drink minimum, and the ticket page says you can arrive any time between 8:30 and midnight.
candidates.fit: Small room, no drink minimum, performers you can see sweat — the Company XIV register at a fraction of the price, and an easy Friday with one or two of the guys or with his wife.

candidates.title: New York Comedy Festival at Brooklyn Comedy Collective
candidates.summary: BCC is running a New York Comedy Festival residency at Eris Evolution from November 6 through 15, all in a small indie theater on Graham Ave. In this window: TGIF with Duchovny & Olestra on Nov 6, Can You Take Our Picture (sketch) and a Clown Revue at 8:30pm on Nov 7, and Rainbow Riot on Nov 8. Next week adds Time to Kill (Nov 10), Close Friends (Nov 11) and Cup of Worms (Nov 13).
candidates.fit: This is the opposite of an arena comedian: 60-odd seats, weird sketch and clown shows, and tickets in the price range of a round of beers. It is the closest thing on a calendar to that Midtown apartment show he loved.

candidates.title: Karaoke Tremendous
candidates.price_text: free RSVP (Eventbrite lists it as registration, not a paid ticket)
candidates.summary: Union Hall's karaoke night takes over the basement room on Friday November 6. It is a registration listing on Eventbrite rather than a paid ticket. Union Hall is the bocce-and-fireplace bar on Union Street with a roughly 100-capacity downstairs.
candidates.fit: He wants to participate, not watch, and karaoke in a 100-person basement with two friends is exactly that. Cheap enough to be the back half of a night that starts with dinner.

candidates.title: Mr. Choade's Upstairs Downstairs
candidates.summary: Billed by the venue as New York City's original variety show, Mr. Choade's runs Saturday November 7 at 8pm at the Slipper Room. A late Midnight Show follows at 10:45pm, with a second show at 12:15 and a dance party after. Price is not listed on the calendar page we read.
candidates.fit: Long-running downtown variety with a real cast rather than a tourist revue, and the midnight option is there if the babysitter is flexible. Same lane as the drag nights at Phoenix he keeps going back for.

candidates.title: Jessie "Jetski" Johnson
candidates.summary: A solo stand-up hour in Union Hall's basement on Thursday November 5, listed on the venue's own calendar with tickets through Eventbrite. The downstairs room seats around 100. Showtime and price were not visible on the calendar page, so check the ticket link.
candidates.fit: His main weeknight slot, a 100-seat basement, and a comic he will not have seen on a podcast — the kind of show where being early matters more than being famous.

candidates.title: The Death of Madame Vivien V
candidates.price_text: about $50 on Shotgun
candidates.summary: House of Yes stages this theatrical murder-mystery production on Saturday November 21 with a 6:30pm start, listed around $50. Early showtime, seated-theatrical format rather than a club night.
candidates.fit: Costumed, participatory, Bushwick, and over early enough to still get a drink after — the register of the Company XIV Halloween show rather than a regular club night.

candidates.title: Skintag and Friends
candidates.summary: A stacked alt-comedy lineup in the Union Hall basement on Friday November 6: Cigi Farmer, Carly Kane, Grace Johnson, Rima Parikh, Molly Kearney and Maddie Connors. Listed on the venue calendar with tickets via Eventbrite; showtime and price are on the ticket page.
candidates.fit: Six comics, one small basement, and names that come off SNL and the Brooklyn circuit rather than off a Netflix billboard — his format exactly.

candidates.title: Michael Longfellow
candidates.summary: Michael Longfellow does a 7:30pm set in Union Hall's roughly 100-seat basement on Tuesday November 3. Listed directly on the venue's calendar with Eventbrite tickets; the calendar page does not show a price.
candidates.fit: A national-touring name in a room smaller than most bars is the trade he keeps saying he wants. It is a Tuesday, so only worth it if he wants an early one — doors to door it is a two-hour night from Fort Greene.

candidates.title: Sophie Duker
candidates.summary: British comedian Sophie Duker plays the Bell House on Thursday November 12, part of the venue's New York Comedy Festival week. The Bell House holds a few hundred standing but is still a bar room, not a theater. Showtime and price need confirming on the venue page.
candidates.fit: A Thursday, in Gowanus, with a comic whose crowd is people who actually follow comedy rather than Instagram clips. Same week the Bell House also has Liza Treyger, Irene Tu and Fahim Anwar on Friday the 13th if that lands better.

candidates.title: Lightscape at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
candidates.price_text: about $44 adults and $28 kids on peak nights
candidates.summary: Lightscape, the Garden's roughly one-mile after-dark light trail, returns for its sixth season from Nov 20, 2026 through Jan 3, 2027, with 16 installations and more than a million lights. Peak-night tickets are listed at $44 for adults and $28 for children. Book timed entry through bbg.org.
candidates.fit: He has done this one and liked it; the only thing that matters now is that the good December slots go early, and it works for either the stroller or his wife.

candidates.title: New York Comedy Festival: Two Thirds of a Threesome
candidates.summary: A New York Comedy Festival show at Littlefield on Thursday November 12 from 8pm to 10pm. Littlefield is the 200-capacity black box on Sackett Street. Ticket price was not visible on the listing we could reach; Littlefield also hosts Tone and The Homies on November 10.
candidates.fit: Thursday, 200 seats, festival pricing — a low-commitment way to catch comics in the room before they move up to theaters.

candidates.title: Art of Manga
candidates.price_text: ticketed exhibition, separate from general admission
candidates.summary: The Brooklyn Museum is running Art of Manga as a ticketed exhibition from October 3, 2026 through January 31, 2027, alongside a free companion show, Manga Before Manga: Japanese Art from the Collection, in the same window. Iris van Herpen's Sculpting the Senses runs through January 3.
candidates.fit: A weekend-morning walk from Fort Greene, stroller-friendly, and genuinely interesting to the adults — it also feeds the Japanese-culture thread that runs through his Daikoku and JDM interest.

candidates.title: Divination at Théâtre XIV: French Kiss lipstick and tarot readings
candidates.summary: Company XIV books lipstick-print readings and tarot appointments at its Bushwick bar, Cocktail Magique, through Eventbrite. It can also be added to a show seat as the French Kiss upgrade, which includes a champagne split, two readings and a keepsake lipstick.
candidates.fit: The pre-show add-on that turns a Nutcracker Rouge ticket into a whole evening, at the one venue in Brooklyn he already trusts. Book the upgrade when he buys seats, not at the door.

candidates.title: Don't Tell Comedy (secret-location shows)
candidates.time_text: usually 7pm or 8:30pm; exact address emailed to ticket holders at 8am the day of the show
candidates.neighborhood: varies by show; Brooklyn and Manhattan neighborhoods listed individually
candidates.summary: Don't Tell Comedy runs pop-up stand-up shows in apartments, shops and other non-venues around New York. You buy by neighborhood, the lineup is not announced, and the address arrives by email at 8am on the day. Shows are usually 21+ and sell out a week or two ahead.
candidates.fit: This is the productized version of the Midtown apartment comedy show he loved. We could not confirm which Brooklyn dates are live in this window — check the New York page and grab whichever Thursday or Saturday is nearest Fort Greene.

candidates.title: First Saturday at the Brooklyn Museum
candidates.price_text: free
candidates.summary: First Saturdays is the museum's free after-hours party: live music, DJs, films, curator talks, art-making and a local marketplace, themed to a current exhibition. The museum states the 2026 season runs on the first Saturday of select months, not every month. We could not confirm a November 7 edition on the museum's own calendar.
candidates.fit: A free, crowded, music-led night at a museum ten minutes from his house is the right kind of culture-as-party. Treat this one as unconfirmed — check the museum calendar before building a plan around it.

candidates.title: Daybreaker HEATWAVE — Sauna Rave at Othership
candidates.price_text: about $84
candidates.summary: Daybreaker's HEATWAVE takes over Othership Williamsburg on Friday Nov 20, 9pm to midnight: guided sauna rounds and cold plunges run by the Othership team, then a DJ set and dancing in swimsuits. The last edition had Diplo behind the decks. There's a second date on Dec 4 and they sell out.
candidates.fit: A full day at the Russian bathhouse was one of his favorite things in the city; this is that plus a proper soundsystem, and it's over by midnight on a Friday.

candidates.title: Bathhouse Atlantic Ave day pass
candidates.time_text: open daily 8am to 11:30pm; day passes in timed slots
candidates.price_text: day passes from $29
candidates.summary: Bathhouse's 32,000-square-foot Atlantic Avenue location opened in 2026 with thermal pools, saunas, steam rooms and an outdoor pool, a few blocks from Barclays Center. Open seven days, 8am to 11:30pm, day passes start at $29 and vary by day and time; massages from $164 include amenity access.
candidates.fit: This is a bathhouse he can walk to from Fort Greene, which makes the full-day-with-a-friend thing he loved at the Russian baths repeatable on a Saturday. Late hours mean it also works as a Thursday-night move with one of the guys instead of a bar.

candidates.title: Bathhouse Williamsburg day pass and Aufguss ritual
candidates.time_text: open daily 8am to 11:30pm; Aufguss sessions run on a posted schedule
candidates.price_text: day passes from $39
candidates.summary: The original Bathhouse location: thermal pools, hot and cold rooms, and the sauna where the first U.S. Aufguss National Championship was held. Open daily 8am to 11:30pm, day passes from $39, treatments from $119. Aufguss towel-waving rituals run inside the main sauna on a rotating schedule.
candidates.fit: He trains Muay Thai a few blocks away in Williamsburg, so a post-session sauna and plunge is an easy add-on, and an Aufguss show is the closest thing sauna culture has to a performance he can sit inside of.

candidates.title: World Spa Brooklyn full-day banya
candidates.time_text: Sun to Thu 10am to 10pm, Fri and Sat 9am to 11pm
candidates.price_text: day passes from $99
candidates.summary: A 16-room mega-bathhouse in south Brooklyn with the largest Grand Banya in the US, venik platza treatments, Turkish and Moroccan hammams, onsen pools, a snow room, cold plunge and an Event Sauna where sauna masters perform Aufguss rituals. Day passes start at $99; there is a full restaurant and lounge so you can stay all day.
candidates.fit: This is the upgrade on the Russian bathhouse day he already counts as a highlight: venik beatings, a snow room and a restaurant so a long Saturday with one friend never has to stop. Not a Manhattan wellness scene, which is the point.

candidates.title: Russian & Turkish Baths, East Village
candidates.summary: The 1892 East Village banya: Russian room, redwood sauna, aromatherapy room, ice-cold pool, roof deck and a kitchen serving borscht and herring upstairs. Management states on the site that they take walk-ins only, with no reservations for the facility, massages or treatments.
candidates.fit: The bathhouse day he already loved, with no booking friction, platza on request and a dining room that makes it a four-hour hang rather than a 90-minute slot. Note the walk-in-only policy, so go early with a friend.

candidates.title: TWA Hotel rooftop pool, winter pool-cuzzi
candidates.time_text: non-hotel guests 11am to 11pm, reservations are 1 hour 45 minutes
candidates.address: One Idlewild Drive, JFK Airport, Queens, NY 11430
candidates.price_text: from $50 per adult for non-hotel guests
candidates.summary: The rooftop infinity pool over JFK's runway 4L/22R stays open all winter and is heated to 95 degrees, with the Pool Bar serving 11am to 11pm daily. Non-hotel guest cover starts at $50 for a 1 hour 45 minute slot; reservations are only required May 1 to November 1, so walk-ins are possible now, subject to space. The hotel notes the pool is closed for maintenance on Thursday, November 3, 2026, from 8am to 6pm.
candidates.fit: He already did the TWA pool day and loved watching planes take off; the winter version, sitting in 95-degree water in the cold while 747s climb out, is the better version and nobody thinks to do it in November.

candidates.title: QC NY spa on Governors Island
candidates.time_text: Sun to Thu 9am to 10pm, Fri and Sat 9am to 11pm; ferry runs from 8:30am
candidates.address: Governors Island, New York, NY (ferry from Battery Maritime Building, 10 South St)
candidates.price_text: about $130 to $190 including the round-trip ferry, depending on day and entry time
candidates.summary: An Italian-run spa in restored officers' housing on Governors Island with outdoor heated panoramic pools facing the Manhattan skyline and the Statue of Liberty, open year-round. Entry includes robe, towels, sandals, locker and the five-minute ferry from the Battery Maritime Building. Third-party listings show entries from roughly $130 for an evening slot up to about $188 for full day.
candidates.fit: A ferry with an actual destination plus outdoor hot pools in the cold is the date-night version of his bathhouse habit, and the sunset entry is the one worth booking. Price is a splurge; he has said that is not the filter.

candidates.title: Othership Williamsburg sauna and ice bath session
candidates.time_text: classes run morning through late evening, roughly 75 to 90 minutes
candidates.summary: Othership's Williamsburg location runs guided group sessions in what it calls the largest performance saunas in North America, with ice bath rooms and an amphitheater-style tea lounge around a fireplace. Sessions are led, with towel-waving, aromatherapy and breathwork, rather than self-guided. It is also the room Daybreaker uses for its HEATWAVE sauna rave.
candidates.fit: Guided, communal and slightly theatrical, which suits him better than a quiet spa; it is also the scouting trip before the Nov 20 sauna rave in the same room. Walkable from his Muay Thai gym.

candidates.title: German Punk — full film series at Anthology
candidates.summary: Eight days of films shot 1979–99 documenting punk in East and West Germany, most of them almost never screened in the US, featuring Einstürzende Neubauten, Die Tödliche Doris, Das Freie Orchester and Nina Hagen. Co-presented by Goethe-Institut New York, Anthology Film Archives and the Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung as part of the international Punk@50 project. Saturday Nov 7 has three programs: "It'll Be OK" at 5:15pm, "Riots and Love" at 7:15pm, "whisper & SHOUT" at 9:15pm.
candidates.fit: If one night isn't enough: the Saturday triple is a whole afternoon-into-night plan around German subculture, which is his lane twice over (Berlin plus small rooms).

candidates.title: German Punk: "Einstürzende Neubauten: Liebeslieder" — with Gudrun Gut in person
candidates.summary: Johanna Schenkel and Klaus Maeck's film on Einstürzende Neubauten, screening Friday Nov 6 at 9pm with Gudrun Gut in person, and again Wednesday Nov 11 at 8:15pm. Programmed by the Goethe-Institut New York as part of Punk@50 at Anthology Film Archives. Ticketing runs through Anthology; no price published on the Goethe page.
candidates.fit: The 9pm slot means you can eat in Fort Greene first and still make it. Neubauten is the root system under a lot of the German music he already listens to, and a Q&A with someone who was in the room beats any arena doc.

candidates.title: German Punk: "No Future" + "Allet United – Punk im Pott"
candidates.summary: Thursday night double feature on punk in the industrial Ruhr region, part of the Goethe-Institut's German Punk series at Anthology. A second program, "Bulky Trash + The Free Orchestra," follows at 8:45pm the same night if you want to stay. Tickets at Anthology; price not listed on the organizer page.
candidates.fit: His main weeknight slot, and a German-language subculture night that nobody in his group chat will have heard about. Two films back to back makes it a plan rather than a drink.

candidates.title: Too Much Is Better Than Too Little: Alfred Hilsberg, ZickZack & the Invention of the German Underground
candidates.time_text: gallery open Thursday to Sunday, 3pm to 8pm
candidates.price_text: free
candidates.summary: First exhibition outside Germany devoted to Alfred Hilsberg and his ZickZack label — rare records, badges, flyers and posters from Christian Iffland's collection, photography by Sabine Schwabroh, and Super-8 films by Klaus Maeck. Curated by Sukhdev Sandhu for Goethe-Institut New York, at the record shop/gallery Various/Artists. Free, and it closes Saturday Nov 7.
candidates.fit: A record-shop-sized room, free, open until 8pm, and about the label that invented Neue Deutsche Welle. Pair it with the Anthology screenings a few blocks north and you have an evening that nobody else planned.

candidates.title: Volkmar and Margret Sander Prize 2026: Johannes von Moltke
candidates.summary: Deutsches Haus at NYU gives its annual Sander Prize to Johannes von Moltke, the Michigan professor of German studies and film who writes on Kracauer, postwar German cinema and the politics of the far right. In-person, 6–8pm, in the small townhouse room at 42 Washington Mews. Deutsches Haus events are RSVP-based; confirm on the event page before going.
candidates.fit: Thirty-odd people in a Greenwich Village townhouse hearing a serious German-studies scholar is about as far from a listicle as you can get, and it's a German-language-world room he can actually talk in.

candidates.title: Viennale Erste Bank Film Award Screening: "White Snail" — Kremser & Peter in person
candidates.summary: Elsa Kremser and Levin Peter, winners of the 2025 Erste Bank Film Award at the Viennale, present their German-Austrian feature "White Snail" with both filmmakers in person. Co-presented by Deutsches Haus at NYU during the directors' residency there, Saturday Nov 7 at 7:30pm at Anthology. Ticket price not stated on the Deutsches Haus page.
candidates.fit: A Saturday-night date that isn't dinner: a German-language film almost nobody here has seen, the directors in the room, and an 80-seat theater. Polished enough for his wife, obscure enough to be worth telling people about.

candidates.title: Tammam Azzam: A New York Debut — artist talk with curator Saria AlMidani
candidates.summary: The Syrian-German artist Tammam Azzam in conversation with curator Saria AlMidani, on the occasion of his first New York solo show. Tuesday Nov 17, 6:30–8:30pm, in the Goethe-Institut's Irving Place space. Price not listed; Goethe-Institut NY programming is typically free with registration.
candidates.fit: A Tuesday, so only worth it because it's small, free-ish and genuinely German-institutional rather than gallery-PR. Good radar item if he wants an evening with actual content behind it.

candidates.title: Tammam Azzam: A Horizon Remains
candidates.time_text: during Goethe-Institut opening hours, Monday to Thursday 10am to 6pm
candidates.price_text: free
candidates.summary: First US institutional presentation and New York solo exhibition of Syrian-German artist Tammam Azzam, on view at the Goethe-Institut through Dec 3, 2026. Free. The building also houses the institute's library and public space.
candidates.fit: A free, twenty-minute stop he can stack with something else, inside the German cultural institute he should be on the mailing list for anyway.

candidates.title: St. Martin's Lantern Walk in Prospect Park (CityKinder)
candidates.address: Near the bandshell and the Ninth Street entrance
candidates.summary: CityKinder's annual Laternenumzug: the German-speaking families of Brooklyn meet near the Prospect Park bandshell at dusk, sing the traditional lantern songs, then process through the park to a reenactment of St. Martin on horseback sharing his cloak. It happens every November, usually on a Saturday around 4:45pm. The 2026 date was not posted on CityKinder's page when I checked — watch that page and their newsletter.
candidates.fit: This is the family pick he's been waiting for: he already plays Lichterkinder lantern songs with the one-year-old, and this is the actual German community doing the actual tradition, carrier-friendly, fifteen minutes from Fort Greene. Flagging it early because the date usually drops days before.

candidates.title: Barbès — nightly small-room programming (klezmer, Balkan brass, Slavic Soul Party)
candidates.time_text: most nights, early set around 7pm and a late set around 9 or 10pm
candidates.price_text: most shows are a door donation collected in the back room
candidates.summary: A back room that holds maybe fifty people, running live music every night for 24 years — Balkan brass, klezmer and Jewish-diaspora music, cumbia, and the long-running Slavic Soul Party residency. The venue states that none of the shows are free: you either pay online in advance or hand over the door charge that night. The specific November 2026 calendar is posted as a PDF on their events page.
candidates.fit: The literal definition of what he asked for: klezmer in a tiny room, no marketing budget, you can talk to the bartender. Check the PDF calendar the week of, pick a Thursday, bring one friend.

candidates.title: Rock and Roll Playhouse weekend kids' concerts
candidates.summary: A real band playing the music of the Beatles, Fleetwood Mac, Bowie or similar for toddlers, in a real venue, on weekend mornings. Brooklyn Bowl in Williamsburg is the regular Brooklyn home. I could not pull the specific November 2026 dates and ticket prices — check the calendar on their site.
candidates.fit: The Beatles and Fleetwood Mac are both heavy in his library, it's done by early afternoon, and it's in Williamsburg where he trains. A kids' thing the adults don't have to endure.

candidates.title: Jalopy Theatre weekend roots and family programming
candidates.time_text: check the calendar; weekend daytime shows run early afternoon
candidates.summary: A 100-seat wooden room attached to a string-instrument shop in Red Hook, running old-time, bluegrass and folk programming including weekend daytime shows that work for small children. I could not load the November 2026 calendar to confirm specific family dates or prices.
candidates.fit: Red Hook is already on his list, the room is tiny, and a toddler is completely normal at a daytime hootenanny there. Stack it with Strong Rope afterwards if the weather holds.

candidates.title: Governors Island ferry day with the kid
candidates.time_text: ferries run through the day; go in the morning and be back for a nap
candidates.summary: The island is open year-round and the boat is the point for a one-year-old. Check govisland.com for the November 2026 ferry schedule and fares before you commit — off-season service is reduced and weekend morning boats are free for some riders.
candidates.fit: The ferry-with-a-destination format he asked for, stroller-friendly end to end, and quiet in November. Fits the 'done by mid-afternoon' rule.

candidates.title: Benji B at Public Records
candidates.summary: Benji B headlines the Sound Room at Public Records on Saturday night, 11pm to 4am, with Cosmo and Louise Chen upstairs and Hidden Spheres plus Francis Harris & Tal in the other room. 21+, bags and coats must be checked, doors close an hour before the end. Tickets through RA; door tickets depend on capacity.
candidates.fit: This is the small-room, serious-soundsystem version of the night he wants: one of the best selectors alive in a 200-capacity Gowanus room, fifteen minutes from Fort Greene, instead of a warehouse with a stage.

candidates.title: German Punk: Girls Bite Back + Road Movie / Einstürzende Neubauten: Liebeslieder (Gudrun Gut in person)
candidates.summary: Anthology runs a 12-part German Punk series November 4–11, co-presented with the German Film Office and Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung, with films shot 1979–99 in West Berlin, East Berlin and the Ruhr. On Friday Nov 6, Berlin legend Gudrun Gut introduces GIRLS BITE BACK + ROAD MOVIE at 6:30pm and EINSTÜRZENDE NEUBAUTEN: LIEBESLIEDER at 9pm. Other nights include NINA HAGEN = PUNK + GLORY (Sun Nov 8, 7:45pm) and BERLIN SUPER 80 (Sun Nov 8, 5pm).
candidates.fit: Berlin-obsessed and German-music-literate: this is rarely-screened Berlin underground footage with one of its actual architects in the room, not a themed night with a marketing budget.

candidates.title: Draußen ist feindlich / Out There is Hostile — German punk panel
candidates.price_text: free, RSVP required
candidates.summary: Gudrun Gut (Malaria!, Mania D), JG Thirlwell and Vivien Goldman sit down at the Goethe-Institut to argue about what German punk and post-punk actually did, and what it means in 2026. Thursday Nov 5, 6:30–8:30pm, free with RSVP through Eventbrite. Part of the Punk@50 series run with Various/Artists.
candidates.fit: A Thursday-night German culture pick with real heavyweights talking, not a language-school mixer — exactly the Goethe-Institut programming he said he wants more of.

candidates.title: Tarka 3-Year Anniversary
candidates.time_text: Sunday, into the night; see Public Records listing
candidates.summary: Public Records closes the week on Sunday Nov 8 with Tarka's three-year anniversary: ZAINAB, Bianca Maieli, Chaia, Zara Dekho b2b Dynoman, Rohana and more. Tarka is a South Asian diaspora party crew that has built its following almost entirely on word of mouth. Tickets through Public Records.
candidates.fit: Community-run party, no marketing budget, a dozen DJs you won't see on a festival poster — the 'you had to know about it' box, and Sunday is easier to sell to a babysitter than 3am Saturday.

candidates.title: Clone Records night: Serge, Detroit In Effect, Afra, Ak-4ya, Louise Chen
candidates.summary: Public Records hands Friday Nov 6 to Rotterdam's Clone Records: label boss Serge plus Afra, with Detroit In Effect and Ak-4ya and Louise Chen across the rooms. Electro and Detroit techno, the deep end of the catalogue. Tickets through Public Records / RA.
candidates.fit: If he wants the Friday that nobody in his group chat has heard of, a Clone Records night in Gowanus is it — machine music in a room where you can still talk to the bartender.

candidates.title: ZickZack closing reception: Alfred Hilsberg and the German underground
candidates.price_text: free
candidates.summary: 'Too Much Is Better Than Too Little,' the first exhibition outside Germany devoted to Alfred Hilsberg and the ZickZack label, closes Saturday Nov 7 with a 6–9pm reception and DJ Maya Hardinge. Rare records, badges, flyers and Super-8 films from the Hamburg underground, curated by Sukhdev Sandhu with the Goethe-Institut. Gallery is a storefront on Essex Street.
candidates.fit: A gallery party in a tiny LES room full of German punk ephemera with a DJ — the art-opening-that-is-actually-a-party format he liked at his wife's friend's photo studio, with a German spine.

candidates.title: HOME MOVIES: Freddy vs Jason with deviant drag
candidates.time_text: evening; check RSVP for start time
candidates.summary: The Nobodies bring their monthly HOME MOVIES night back to All Night Skate on Sunday Nov 8, pairing drag performances with a screening of Freddy vs Jason. It's a bar-room series, not a cinema — drinks, hosts, and a movie everyone talks over. Details are on the organizers' Instagram.
candidates.fit: All Night Skate is already one of his spots and drag-plus-cinema in a bar back room is the same register as the Rocky Horror night in Flatbush.

candidates.title: Cold Plunge Comedy with Adam Pally, Isabel Hagen, Ahamed Weinberg
candidates.summary: Cold Plunge Comedy's Wednesday Nov 4 show at 7:30pm is announced with Adam Pally, Isabel Hagen, Ahamed Weinberg and Noneefizzle. Stand-up performed for a room of people in and around a cold plunge. Tickets are via the link on their Instagram; the venue is not named in the post.
candidates.fit: Cold plunge plus small-room stand-up is a two-for-one on his actual interests, and it is participatory rather than spectating — the only reason to break his no-Wednesday rule.

candidates.title: OSGEMEOS at Elsewhere (free with RSVP)
candidates.price_text: free with RSVP
candidates.summary: Elsewhere's just-announced list has OSGEMEOS on Friday Nov 6, free with RSVP. The Brazilian twin artists behind the Lincoln Center and Hirshhorn murals also DJ, and Elsewhere is running it as a free club night. RSVP through Elsewhere's calendar.
candidates.fit: Free, in Bushwick, and the sort of thing that fills on word of mouth rather than a listicle — a good low-stakes Friday to pull two friends into.

candidates.title: THE DEVILS (uncensored 4K restoration)
candidates.summary: Ken Russell's banned-for-decades THE DEVILS screens in a new uncensored 4K restoration at Nitehawk Williamsburg on Nov 7 and 8, then at Nitehawk Prospect Park on Nov 14 and 15. Nitehawk serves food and drinks at the seat. Showtimes and tickets on nitehawkcinema.com.
candidates.fit: He trains in Williamsburg and likes the dressed-up, slightly deranged side of repertory film; this is the most notorious restoration of the year, not a Saturday blockbuster.

candidates.title: Young Adult Friction emo dance party (NY Comedy Fest weekend)
candidates.summary: Union Hall's New York Comedy Festival weekend post lists Young Adult Friction at midnight on Saturday Nov 7, after Charlie Flynn at 5pm and the Tessa Belle / Freddie Shanel show at 10pm. Young Adult Friction is Union Hall's emo and 2000s dance party in the basement room. Tickets at unionhallny.com.
candidates.fit: Emo night with the guys in a basement that holds a couple hundred people, stacked on top of comedy earlier in the evening — the 2000s pop-punk streak in his library, no arena required.

candidates.title: Batsheva in the galleries: Seven Circles
candidates.summary: On Sunday Nov 8 designer Batsheva stages bridal and occasion looks inside 'Modernity and Opulence: Women of the Wiener Werkstätte,' with models circling the galleries seven times in the manner of a bride under the chuppah and taking questions from visitors. The exhibition itself closes Nov 15. Details and admission through thejewishmuseum.org.
candidates.fit: Jewish cultural programming that is actually a performance rather than a lecture, and a Sunday-afternoon date that does not require a 9pm babysitter.

candidates.title: Sandbox Percussion: Andy Akiho's Seven Pillars
candidates.summary: Sandbox Percussion performs Andy Akiho's evening-length Seven Pillars in Buttenwieser Hall at 92NY on Saturday Nov 7 at 7:30pm. It's a lit, staged percussion quartet piece the group has toured for years. Tickets at 92ny.org.
candidates.fit: Small hall, four players, music built out of rhythm and light — a date-night alternative to a big concert hall that still feels like a real event.

candidates.title: DJ Harvey with Kenny Dope and Dee Diggs
candidates.summary: Knockdown Center has DJ Harvey back in the Main Hall on Friday Nov 13, joined by Kenny Dope (Masters at Work) and Dee Diggs. Knockdown says limited tickets remain, sold through DICE. The Ruins are closed for the season, so this is indoors.
candidates.fit: Harvey and Kenny Dope on one bill is the once-in-a-while big-room night that is still a DJ show, not a festival stage — book it now rather than reading about it after.

candidates.title: Nutcracker Rouge — Company XIV
candidates.price_text: from $35 on TodayTix, $39 most Fri/Sat, $49 in December
candidates.summary: Company XIV's baroque-burlesque Nutcracker opens Nov 12 and runs through Jan 30 at Théâtre XIV in Bushwick, 21+, about two hours with an intermission. Petite Rouge closed on Halloween, so this is the next thing they stage. Tickets start at $35 and climb through December.
candidates.fit: He already rates Company XIV and he rates the Nutcracker; this is both, in a 150-seat Bushwick room with champagne service, and December dates go first.

candidates.title: Mixtape Night with New York Emos
candidates.price_text: free with RSVP
candidates.summary: New York Emos and Grrrl Afraid host a free mixtape-burning night at All Night Skate on Thursday Nov 12: submit a playlist in advance, they burn it to CD, you decorate the sleeve and trade with strangers. RSVP is free through the link on their Instagram. Limited pre-made mixes will be there too.
candidates.fit: Thursday, free, in a bar he likes, and you actually make something instead of standing around — the small, weird, participatory end of the scene.

candidates.title: BELA LUGOSI MEETS A BROOKLYN GORILLA + Dave the Spazz afterparty
candidates.time_text: evening screening, afterparty follows in Trees Lounge
candidates.summary: Nitehawk Prospect Park screens a new scan of the lowbrow classic BELA LUGOSI MEETS A BROOKLYN GORILLA on Thursday Nov 12, introduced by WFMU's Dave the Spazz, who signs his new Sammy Petrillo book at an afterparty in the downstairs Trees Lounge. Tickets through nitehawkcinema.com.
candidates.fit: Thursday night, a 1950s trash movie nobody has seen, and a bar hang afterward with the guy who programmed it — small, strange, and easy to sell to one friend.

candidates.title: Durations: Philosophy + Magic
candidates.summary: Durations, a week-long festival of talks and club programming run with Triple Canopy and Unsound, puts Philosophy + Magic upstairs at Public Records on Friday Nov 13: individual readings plus conversations with four writers, led by Meredith Graves and Offal Salon. The same festival includes an experimental short film program on Sunday Nov 15 at 1pm with club programming at 4pm. Tickets via Public Records.
candidates.fit: Talks and a dancefloor in the same building, run by people with no marketing budget — the deep-culture version of a Friday night rather than another lineup poster.

candidates.title: Einstein on the Beach 50th Anniversary Concert
candidates.summary: The Philip Glass Ensemble performs the Einstein on the Beach 50th Anniversary Concert at BAM on Nov 19, 20 and 21, with performers from past productions alongside new ones. BAM lists it as part of its November season. Tickets at bam.org.
candidates.fit: It is literally in his front yard, it is the fiftieth anniversary of the piece that broke opera, and it is the kind of big-spectacle culture night he books a few times a year.

candidates.title: Maccabee Bar NYC (Hanukkah pop-up)
candidates.time_text: evenings; reservations open on a rolling 30-day basis
candidates.summary: Maccabee Bar, the Hanukkah cocktail pop-up, returns to New York inside Saint Tuesday at the Walker Hotel starting December 1 and runs through New Year's Eve. Reservations open on a rolling 30-day basis, so December 1 opens roughly now. A Boston edition opens Black Friday at Noir in Cambridge.
candidates.fit: He loved the Hanukkah-themed cocktail bar last time; this one is in a basement speakeasy rather than a lobby, and the good nights get booked out a month ahead.

candidates.title: Scenic Route x MWL end of year party
candidates.summary: Scenic Route and MWL take over Elsewhere on Dec 11 for their annual end-of-year party, with live performances from MWL, That Boi Aka That Boi, 0perelly, Holidays In United States and Ivy Knight, plus DJs Anysia Kym and Sap Magazine. Announced on the organizers' Instagram; tickets through Elsewhere.
candidates.fit: A scene party thrown by a crew rather than a promoter, with live acts and DJs in one room — closer to the photo-studio party he liked than to a club booking.

candidates.title: Omnium Circus at BAM
candidates.time_text: matinee and evening performances across four days
candidates.summary: Omnium Circus makes its BAM debut Dec 10–13, an award-winning company built around full accessibility and inclusion, with ringmaster Malik Paris and a cast of international circus performers. BAM is selling tickets now through bam.org.
candidates.fit: A walk from his door, loud and visual enough for a one-year-old in a carrier, and genuinely watchable for the adults — better than another playground Saturday.

candidates.title: Afrobeat Nights (Fall Series)
candidates.summary: Afrobeat Nights brings its amapiano and Afrobeats fall series to The Sultan Room in Bushwick on Saturday Nov 28, 11pm to 4am. It's a recurring Brooklyn party rather than a one-off booking. Listing found on an events aggregator; confirm on the venue's own calendar before buying.
candidates.fit: Afrobeats and amapiano are his current listening phase and The Sultan Room is a 200-cap room above a bar, not a club with a table minimum.

candidates.title: Threes Brewing Friendsgiving tables
candidates.price_text: no deposit required
candidates.summary: Threes Brewing is taking reservations all November, Monday to Thursday, for groups up to 10 at both Gowanus and Greenpoint — unusual for a taproom that normally doesn't book tables. Drink specials include ginger margarita and black lager pitchers, with the full Grand Army food menu and platters available to pre-order. Email events@threesbrewing.com to lock a table; the Gowanus tented yard is back up for the winter.
candidates.fit: He wants to be the one who already has the plan: a guaranteed table for eight on a Thursday in November, with a heated yard, solves Friendsgiving before anyone else starts a group chat about it.

candidates.title: Art of Manga and Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
candidates.time_text: museum hours; weekend mornings are quietest
candidates.summary: The Brooklyn Museum is running 'Art of Manga' alongside 'Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses,' which has been extended through January 3, 2027, and is programming manga-inspired and family activities through November. Tickets through brooklynmuseum.org.
candidates.fit: Stroller-friendly, ten minutes from Fort Greene, and the van Herpen couture show is strong enough that the adults aren't just killing a Saturday morning.

Sources that failed: knockdown.center (url_not_accessible, so all Knockdown items are secondary-sourced from Jambase/Bandsintown/AXS/SeatGeek and marked likely); teksupport.nyc (url_not_allowed); ra.co listing and club pages (geolocate to Columbus and do not render event lists); avant-gardner.com returned a stale 2025 cache.

Scene context worth knowing: a New Jersey court ordered TCE Presents, the parent of Teksupport, to cease all operations effective November 7, 2026. Their last listed event is Teksupport: Volkoder at The Chocolate Factory on Fri Nov 6, and it is sold out. Brooklyn Storehouse at the Navy Yard also closed after its Halloween CircoLoco finale, and the Brooklyn Mirage is shut for the season. So the big-warehouse pipeline that normally carries the melodic-house bookings is thin right now - that is why this week leans on Public Records, Good Room, Elsewhere and Knockdown.

Prices: Public Records, Good Room and Elsewhere do not publish ticket prices on their calendars; everything routes to Dice, RA or Eventbrite. I left those price fields empty rather than guess. Expect roughly $20-40 for the club nights at those three rooms based on their normal range, but treat that as unverified.

Thirlwell (Foetus) discussion, a Felix Kubin performance called "German Tape Delinquents," a Seth Howes talk on East German punk activism, and a Maya Hardinge DJ set of female German musicians.
